# KITTY CORP

> Premier AI Robotics & Physical-World Intelligence Venture.
> Official Website: https://thekittycorp.com
> Commercial Digital Studio: https://demo.thekittycorp.com

KITTY CORP is an AI robotics venture exploring the future of physical-world intelligence. We design, research, and engineer intelligent autonomous mechanical systems to solve foundational challenges in agriculture, clean energy, and physical operations.

## Core Research Divisions

### 01 AGRIYAAN — Autonomous Agricultural Robotics
- **Focus**: AI for Smarter Agriculture.
- **Technology**: Multi-spectral crop scanning, terrain mobility chassis, autonomous field navigation, real-time yield analytics, and soil telemetry.
- **Status**: Concept Exploration & Field Research.

### 02 GREEN ENERGY — Intelligent Clean Energy Systems
- **Focus**: AI for a Sustainable Future.
- **Technology**: Dynamic wind turbine aerodynamic control, automated solar array tracking, predictive microgrid balancing, and battery energy storage optimization.
- **Status**: Concept Exploration & Simulation Modeling.
